issues.title: Preview shutdown requires a supported retained handle

issues.compatibility_plan: Future interactive preview helpers use retained TTY/control capability or an explicit exact ownership stop contract; never broad process killing.

issues.evidence_needed: One attributable process ownership witness before stopping a background helper.
issues.boundary: No host feature, privilege, security or unrelated process change is authorized.
